title: Reported Relay succeeded before native session completion (unverified)
symptom: A discrepancy between Relay run status and the Harness native session lifecycle was reported; available cited evidence does not establish the exact timestamped ordering for the same run.
resolution: Investigate using correlated timestamps and IDs for exactly one Relay run and its native Harness session; confirm native terminal state and stable artifacts before accepting or retrying. This is a proposed safeguard, not a verified repair of the reported ordering defect.
prevention: Regression test must reproduce the same run's Relay succeeded event before a later native running=false event; enforce idempotent handoff and independent Codex verification only after that evidence is captured.
